execution_chains.name: postruntime-redis-attempt1
argv:
local queues = {'mjobs-application','mjobs-discovery','mjobs-company-discovery','mjobs-ai','mjobs-document'}
local allowed = {}
for _,q in ipairs(queues) do allowed['rq:queue:'..q] = true end
for _,key in ipairs(redis.call('SMEMBERS','rq:queues')) do
 if not allowed[key] then return redis.error_reply('UNEXPECTED_REGISTERED_QUEUE') end
end
local counts = {}
for _,q in ipairs(queues) do
 table.insert(counts,redis.call('LLEN','rq:queue:'..q))
 table.insert(counts,redis.call('LLEN','rq:queue:'..q..':intermediate'))
 table.insert(counts,redis.call('ZCARD','rq:wip:'..q))
 table.insert(counts,redis.call('ZCARD','rq:scheduled:'..q))
 table.insert(counts,redis.call('ZCARD','rq:deferred:'..q))
end
return counts
